title: Grammar Error Pattern by Topic
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lesson:complete error_topic=*
| stats count as errors by target_language error_topic
| sort - errors
description: Ranks the grammar topics that produce the most mistakes across your lessons.
value: Repeated grammar misses point to targeted study needs that streaks and XP totals hide.
implementation: Log grammar error topics in `lesson:complete`; count error frequency by language and topic.
visualization: Bar chart of grammar errors by topic.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which grammar ideas keep tripping you up so you can study the right weak spots.
